instrument: Nikon Eclipse Ti2-E single-layer documentary reconstruction with virtual camera crop
independentBasis: Use Nikon DS-Qi2 nominal 7.3 µm sensor pixel and a fixed 400×256 pixel crop with 1× camera relay. A 36.5 µm reticle pitch projects to 365/7.3=50 pixels at 10× and 730/7.3=100 at 20×; the same fixed 2920 µm sensor width spans 292 and 146 µm in object space. Compare line peaks in rendered image rather than using nominal grid pitch as the measurement.
tolerance: 0.05 pixels for independent line recovery, 1e-7 for unit/metric comparisons. Synthetic optics only.
